First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 03-27-1186.  
Subtract 180 days:  

1186 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1186 not divisible by 4).  
From 03-27 back 180 days:  

Step 1: Back to start of March: 27 days in March → subtract 27 days → date is 03-01-1186. Remaining: 180 - 27 = 153 days left to subtract.  

Step 2: Go back through February (28 days in 1186) and January (31 days):  
February: 28 days → 153 - 28 = 125 left.  
January: 31 days → 125 - 31 = 94 left. Now we are at 01-01-1186.  

Step 3: Go back into previous year 1185 (which is not a leap year either):  
December 1185: 31 days → 94 - 31 = 63 left.  
November: 30 days → 63 - 30 = 33 left.  
October: 31 days → 33 - 31 = 2 left.  
September: 30 days → but we only need 2 days back from October 1.  

October 1, 1185 minus 2 days = September 29, 1185.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1185-09-29
